タイトル: コスト面よし、操作性には改善の余地あり
投稿者: 匿名レビュアー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "コスト面よし、操作性には改善の余地あり"
良い点: 最も優れている点は導入コストの低さです。複数のサービスを比較しましたが、初期費用・月額費用ともに最も安く、必要な機能を無理なく導入できました。小規模事業者でも導入しやすく、コストを抑えたい場合に非常に魅力的だと感じています。
改善点: 最も改善してほしい点は操作性です。国内OTAとの接続はサポートへの依頼が必要で手間に感じました。また、誤操作を避けるため触ってはいけないボタンがある点も分かりにくいです。管理画面がより直感的になり、ユーザーだけで設定や操作が完結できるとさらに使いやすくなると思います。

タイトル: Beds24を１ヶ月使っての感想(自社サイト予約エンジン搭載した人)
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす Beds24.comからの返信
良い点: サポートセンターの対応です。土日以外なら2日以内に返事が来るので、安心感が有ります。また、文章だけじゃなくて、ちゃんと写真やスクリーンショットを併用して説明して貰えるので、分かりやすいです。自社サイト予約エンジンを無料搭載できるのも良いです。
改善点: 予約エンジンのデザイン性。無料なので贅沢は言えませんが(￣▽￣;)何となく簡素な感じの仕様なので、かたいというか、可愛くない感じがします。笑 自社サイトをデザイン性とどうしても乖離してしまうので、一貫性を持たせにくいです。外部サイトに飛ばされた印象があります。

タイトル: １棟貸なら必須だと思います。
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす 千尋 日本の不動産業 不動産, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "１棟貸なら必須だと思います。"
良い点: カスタマイズ性が高く、自分の好きなように構築できる点が優れていると感じます。 痒いところに手が届く性能で、使いたい機能が多く実装されています。 分からないときはカスタマーセンターに連絡することで、迅速に対応してくれるところも魅力です。
改善点: 設定項目が多岐に渡るまで、操作に慣れるまで使いにくく感じました。 その他、月額費用に含まれている予約サイトが少し安っぽいデザインだと感じます。 もう少し格好良いデザインになると、さらに良くなると感じます。

タイトル: 全体的に良いと思います
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす Beds24.comからの返信
良い点: 安い。 PMSとサイトコントローラーが1つのサイトで完結するので楽。 あと予約エンジンつかえるのが非常に大きい決め手でした。 実際、予約エンジン使えるのはありがたいです。 料金は上げないでほしいです。
改善点: サイトのGUI、使いづらいと感じる。 特に予約エンジンの画像の入れ方とかわかりづらい。 マニュアルを、もっともっと充実させてほしい。マニュアル見ながら誰でもできるように。 あとテンプレートも少ない。 電話での問い合わせもっと気軽にさせてほしい。 楽天、じゃらんが高すぎる。

タイトル: コストパフォーマンスが高い
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす 龍亮 日本の個人事業主 レジャー、旅行、観光, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "コストパフォーマンスが高い"

タイトル: 技術サポートをメールの他に電話でもできればいう事なし

タイトル: Excelente Sistema a muy buen precio!
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす Andres メキシコのAdministrador 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excelente Sistema a muy buen precio!"
良い点: Lo mejor de este sistema es que, por su precio, cumple lo que muchos otros prometen. Aunque puede no ser tan llamativo como otros sistemas existentes, al usarlo te das cuenta de que es el que más cumple y te ayuda a ahorrar dinero. Otros sistemas suelen basarse más en estrategias de marketing para aparentar mayor valor y justificar un precio más alto, pero sus herramientas realmente deberían costar lo que Beds24 cobra, un precio justo.
改善点: Verse un poco anticuado en comparación con otros, pero la verdad es que, si uno lo piensa, al momento de trabajar y practicar en este sistema, uno se acostumbra, y ese es el detalle que menos importa.

タイトル: A cheap basic PMS. Not many bells and whistles.
投稿者: 匿名レビュアー ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A cheap basic PMS. Not many bells and whistles."
良い点: The cost. It was an inexpensive PMS where I only paid for what I needed, and it was customizable for my small hotel. It was fairly easy to use, but there was a learning curve. They did not require a contract.
改善点: Many things. First, support was only available by email, and their support team was based in Germany, working only during their business hours. They would demand that you look at their FAQs, and their responses were often condescending if you asked a question that was addressed in their FAQs (but usually a different scenario). Every aspect of their product had a separate price, and configuring things required a lot of trial and error. Many things that were possible with other PMSs were not possible with Beds24, such as an easy-to-use interface and some reports (such as a pace report). Moving customers between dates and rooms was not easy, and it sometimes caused the system to hang. Connections to OTAs were straightforward, but not easy. It did not have an interface to charge credit cards, so pre-authorizations were a time-consuming process.

投稿者: Axel アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Best value, most configurable PMS-Channel manager there is"
良い点: To me, Beds24 is the holy grail and the antithesis to the plethora of terrible PMS and hotel software out there that overcharge for bad software and poor service. Beds24 is inexpensive and extremely configurable and five you full control. I highly recommend Beds24 if you're very technical. You're not going to find a more configurable and adaptable solution on the market, Beds24 is hands down the best PMS/Channel manager platform that exists and it can be fully customized, I mean every aspect of the system can be configured. We've tried several solutions in the hotel space, and most of them were so buggy it wasn't worth the effort, and they were limiting in that they provided only one way of doing things that often wouldn't fit with how we run our business. So we wanted a solution that would give us full control where we didn't have to rely on the company support to run things. Beds24 is that solution. It's a 100% do it yourself solution with so many developer insert points that make it a dream for a software engineer like me. For example you can inject JS, CSS and HTML in all aspects of the direct booking journey, making it easy to customize. The API is fantastic and is probably the biggest strength of Beds24. You don't need to rely on someone to import your reservations into the system, you can do it all yourself.
改善点: The only con I can think of is their support but I wouldn't use that as a criteria. Let's face it, support in the software industry as a whole is really bad and Beds24 is no exception, so I don't recommend using support as a metric on who to choose. At Beds24, Support is difficult to get for real bugs, just like it is in most companies. They are nice in providing help with how to use the product correctly, but when it comes to real bugs, do not expect much support. It's almost as if they must get pay deductions for every bug they report to engineering. For example, our booking engine for one of our property started to load units from another property upon checkout even though the other property has nothing to do with the booking engine, trying to get help was practically impossible. I will also say that their help system is a limiting homegrown solution where you cannot properly attach URLs or any image attachments, it's not really what one expects for 2025 style support, making the process of getting help cumbersome and difficult. The platform unfortunately does have mission critical bugs, and we did not have any luck getting support from them for those. The best way around those is to figure out under what circumstances they happen and then use the product in a way that doesn't cause the issues. タイトル: Sehr leistungsfähiges PMS und Channelmanagement
投稿者: Heiko ドイツのOwner レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Sehr leistungsfähiges PMS und Channelmanagement"
良い点: Ich nutze beds24 sowohl als Vermittler von Ferienhäusern sowie ebenso als Vermieter. Das Buchungssystem und Channelmanagement ist sehr flexibel und hat sehr viele Möglichkeiten das System für die eigenen Bedürfnisse zu konfigurieren. Die Automatisierung von wichtigen Prozessen und Abläufen und der Kommunikation mit den Feriengästen wird sehr vereinfacht und ermöglicht Unternehmenswachstum und Zeiteinsparungen.
改善点: Die vielen Möglichkeiten führen dazu, das man aufpassen muss sich nicht in den Möglichkeiten zu verlieren. Eigentlich ein Vorteil, aber es kann dazu führen das man den roten Faden verlieren kann.

タイトル: Solid solution if you do not depend on the Booking Engine
投稿者: S Olaf ブラジルのBusiness Owner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Solid solution if you do not depend on the Booking Engine"
良い点: Highly configurable and seemed very complete upon first Due Diligence.
改善点: The Booking Engine only serves when you do NOT intend to implement differentiated pricings for seasonal holidays and the likes. Also do stay clear of the APIs, the underpinning data architecture is one pot of noodles that can not be made sense of via the APIs. We found out the pricey way, three months of development work down the drain.

タイトル: Simply the best PMS solution
投稿者: David オーストラリアのDirector レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Simply the best PMS solution"
良い点: The best feature of this product is the flexibility. Thanks to the auto action function, you can make the system do almost anything you want it to. In an age of increased efficiency and automation, this makes beds24 the ideal product. I'm still only just realising half of the things I can automate, meaning that as I continue using the product, I will be able to continue increasing my efficiencies. The next best, but very much related, characteristic is its ability to integrate with other systems. There's no point trying to be the best at everything. Beds24 gets the nuts and bolts perfect, then makes sure you can hook into other systems extremely easily to fine tune your total tech package.
改善点: Because it is a completely DIY system, it can be quite daunting getting set-up. You have to figure out how to do everything by following the self-help guides. Having said that, you can pay for support sessions if you're finding it difficult. But I would say the only fault of the system is it may turn some people away for not knowing what they have to do. Get past that, and you're in for a wonderful reward.

タイトル: Manage my property details in one place
投稿者: Rinus フランスのOwner ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Manage my property details in one place"
良い点: When I joined Beds24 I was pleased that they have wizards to take me thought the basic setup to get me online quickly. They have an extensive help library, with step by step instructions and examples. I can manage my properties, prices and calendar all in one place. Connecting to the OTAs helps ensure that I keep my calendar upto date. I can quickly change prices when needed and the details are updated to the channels, saves me time rather than having to remember to login to different systems updating calendars and prices. I can collect payments from my guests and send them emails automatically. I don't need to remember to do it any more.
改善点: I am not very good with computers so at the beginning there was a lot to learn, but the wizards, help pages and support team made it easier and it didn't take long to complete my setup.

タイトル: Power, Reliability, Flexibility
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Power, Reliability, Flexibility"
良い点: Beds24, unlike a lot of PMS platforms, does what it says it will, reliably, every time. This is crucial in our industry where guest expectations are high and failure is unacceptable. The level of API connectivity to OTA channels is way above the majority of the competitors and if you look on Booking.com you will see the reliability is in some case 15-20% above that of some of the big name platforms. The team at B24 are responsive to customer needs and make small and big enhancements to the system on an ongoing basis. The API is powerful and we have used it in a number of different circumstances now to enhance guest experience.
改善点: The User Interface has a steep learning curve, but once you have it clear in your mind then it's fine. It may not be as beautiful as some, but I've learned the hard way and appreciate B24 reliability, scalability and functionality over pretty screens... I would like to see a native mobile app on IOS and Andriod as well as integration to additional pricing tools like Beyond Pricing and Wheelhouse.

タイトル: Benutzerfreundlich - unendliche Möglichkeiten - tadellose Unterstützung - kein 08/15 Produkt
投稿者: Jean ドイツのGeschäftsführer レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Benutzerfreundlich - unendliche Möglichkeiten - tadellose Unterstützung - kein 08/15 Produkt"
良い点: Ich benutze beds24 seit über 5 Jahren und ich bin immer noch fasziniert von den Möglichkeiten, die diese Software anbietet, da diese kein 08/15 Produkt ist. Es gibt sooo viele Elemente und es kommen immer wieder neue, so dass man mehr Lust bekommt sich damit zu beschäftigen. Ich kann alles einwandfrei verwalten (Preise und Verfügbarkeiten , keine Doppelbuchungen, Schnittstellen, Automation, Angebote, Rechnungen, Voucher, Berichte...usw). Seit ich diese Software verwende, ist meine Arbeit Kinderleicht geworden. Allerdings muss man am Anfang Zeit investieren, wenn man viele features verwenden möchte. Zu diesem Punkt braucht man eine unkomplizierte support Hilfe, die man bei beds24 mit Sicherheit bekommt. Als letztes möchte ich noch erwähnen, dass der Preis-Leistung-Verhältnis der beste mit Abstand war und ist.
改善点: Am Anfang bekommt man den Eindruck, dass es eine komplizierte Software ist, was man aber sehr schnell feststellt, dass es nicht ist.

タイトル: Kein Service, kein Telefon, kein Live chat. Reinstes Chaos. Wie es aussieht was für Bastler
投稿者: Andreas ドイツのBerater レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Kein Service, kein Telefon, kein Live chat. Reinstes Chaos. Wie es aussieht was für Bastler"
良い点: Eine Integration in bestehende Prozesse war bisher nicht möglich, da die Software fehleranfällig ist. Es werden Synchronisationsfehler angezeigt, Daten nur teilweise übertragen. Vorteil erschließt sich mir bis jetzt nicht. Aber schlecht ist das alle bisherigen Buchungen und Kalender blockiert werden anstatt zu synchronisieren. Gerade jetzt kurz vor den Feiertagen besonders ärgerlich.
改善点: Es gibt keinen telefonischen Support. Bei der Übertragung von booking.com sind alle Preise und Verfügbarkeiten verschwunden. Alle accounts bei booking.com wurden seitens des Channel Managers gesperrt und seit Stunden nicht wieder freigegeben. Eine Wiederherstellung der Daten wurde zugesichert per Ticket (einzigste Kommunikationsform, welche sehr schleppend und zeitlich verzögert läuft) aber ist bis heute nicht erfolgt. Bei wiederholter Anfrage wird auf erneute Eingabe der Daten verwiesen.

タイトル: Every solution in one single subscription
投稿者: Fabrizio イタリアのSenior Communication Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Every solution in one single subscription"
良い点: How complete it is, i got to know this software because a few years ago i was looking for a channel manager which could connect to many booking.com accounts at once. Beds24 did exactly what i needed. Not counting all the updates with new functionalities. We increased from 25% to 45% in direct bookings as well because the platform for online payment is secure and customers do feel safe using it.
改善点: Sometimes it's abit difficult to because of all it's functions, but here again i just open a ticket and help is quick and precise.

タイトル: Ease of Use, Good Functionality and Definitely Worth
投稿者: Firman インドネシアのManaging Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Ease of Use, Good Functionality and Definitely Worth"
良い点: We have currently using more than one PMS to this day , but Beds24 gives the most worth of your money with features and usability. The user interface is easy to understand and navigate, we can easily create and manage property as well as new room without long learning curve, add new room, configure room amenities, configure offers per room type and publish to OTA through channel manager only take less than 15 minutes for a whole process. Later on, updating the price and offers per OTA is also very easy, In short,costs incurred for the use of beds 24 is highly commensurate with the variety of features and conveniences provided
改善点: Still the lack of feature integration with point of sales system or the front desk for a large scale hotel

タイトル: We use Beds24 for our cottage resort on Golden Lake, Ontario, Canada. And we like it.
投稿者: Alexander カナダのWriter 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "We use Beds24 for our cottage resort on Golden Lake, Ontario, Canada. And we like it."
良い点: This is a most versatile and reasonably prices software we every found for our resort. Amazing flexibility and unlimited customization for the any needs of hospitality establishment. Tech support is fast, the documentation is sufficient and well organized. We also like video tutorials and contextual help.
改善点: It is became more and more sophisticated year to year, so for now we need more assistance from tech. support to set up new options. Although, this assistance is free so all issues are resolved in the reasonable time.
